$comment: Inputs for the entity-graph check and the weekly sameAs watch. The sameAs lists themselves live in the entity sources below (the published schema files) and nowhere else; this file only names them. profiles_pending holds profiles that are named but not yet claimed or not yet resolving: they never enter sameAs until the watch sees them resolve. Read by _ops/validators/validate_entity_graph.js and scripts/authority/entity_backlink_watch.mjs.
